title: Project configuration
description: Declared intent for one analysis project. This file states what to analyse and under which policies; it never states what was measured. A value here cannot become a claim about a reference — `$kind: reference-fact` is refused by the loader, because a preference that could masquerade as a fact would be indistinguishable from one downstream.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped when this file's shape changes in a way that breaks reading it. A newer version is `unsupported`, not `invalid` — the file may be perfectly good and simply from a later build.

bigaapVersion.description: The tool version that created the project. Read from package.json so it cannot drift from the tool. `null` means the build could not read its own version — a real condition on a damaged install, reported as a blocker by `bigaap doctor`. It is null rather than a placeholder version because a placeholder is indistinguishable from a genuine reading, which is exactly how def_0039 stayed invisible.

projectId.description: Stable across moves and renames: derived from name and creation time, never from a path.

workspaceRoot.description: Relative to this file. Analysis workspaces live under it.

reference.description: The reference to analyse. Null until configured — a project without one is `incomplete`, not broken.

configurationStatus.description: Five states, deliberately not three. `incomplete` is a project that can be worked on but not yet analysed; `unsupported` is one this build cannot read. Collapsing either into `invalid` would send a user to fix something that is not wrong.

$kind.description: `reference-fact` is deliberately absent. Configuration states intent; only evidence states facts.
